quote: Sorry, but I just can't get behind this game. Not sure what the critics are smoking. Would return it if I could.

author: 4DTravelr
quote:
Beautiful re-envisioning of the game that started it all. Some may have lost sight of it in the BotW/TotK era, but this is the foundation for the 3D action/adventure and is a timeless and superior design.

The beauty of this game is that despite being only 30-50 hours (depends how completionist you are), it feels longer than the open air titles due to its density - quality over quantity is key here, and immersion is unparalleled.

Importantly, you find yourself caring about the world, its characters, Zelda and Link, and the fate of Hyrule. I can only hope the younger Nintendo devs are inspired by the fan reaction and outpouring of love here in designing future Zelda games.

The only possible nitpick is voice acting - it has improved from BotW/TotK but is still not quite good enough. We are almost there, just step it up one more time in the next game and we'll have arrived.

Combat feels fantastic though and this represents the modernization of OoT's combat speed and tactility to match, and even exceed, that of Wind Waker, Twilight Princess, and Skyward Sword. This absolutely is a return to form for Zelda combat and this I think represents the unsung triumph of the game. Zelda always had gratifying combat that was unique across gaming - while slo-mo bow jumping was fun in the Wild era, swordplay suffered. No longer.

Lastly, it must be said that this game is gorgeous - you will get to know the screenshot button. 

Just like with the original, this release represents a pivotal moment for Nintendo and especially Zelda. Back then, it pioneered the 3D era, during which timeless legends and heartfelt stories were told and born. Now, it re-grounds the franchise after an exciting, fanbase-expanding, yet meandering diversion back to its roots, new fans in tow, for the next generation.

As it was then, so it now too shall be. The Hero of Time, clad it green, has returned to save not just Hyrule, but the Zelda franchise itself.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
